snippet.title: VRider SBK - Steam & PS VR2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Currently available on Meta Quest and Pico, VRider SBK™ is coming soon to SteamVR and PlayStation VR2.
The game features enhanced graphics, up to 22 AI riders, and 14 meticulously recreated real-world circuits. Compete for the best lap times on shared cross-platform leaderboards for SteamVR, Meta, and Pico (PS VR2 support coming soon).

🔗 Website: https://vridergame.com/
🎮 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014224
🖥️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145740/VRider_SBK/
